WITH region_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    d.A3 as region,
    COUNT(c.client_id) as client_count
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
total_clients AS (
  SELECT SUM(client_count) as total FROM region_counts
),
region_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    r.region,
    r.client_count,
    r.client_count / CAST(t.total AS REAL) as share
  FROM region_counts r
  CROSS JOIN total_clients t
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM region_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT r.region, r.client_count, r.share, a.avg_share
  FROM region_shares r
  CROSS JOIN average_share a
  WHERE r.share > a.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(client_count) as total_clients,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_above_average
FROM above_average
